caption:
Your quote is losing to a format nobody opens.

Most shops still send it as an emailed PDF. It lands in an inbox folder next to the receipts and the spam, and nobody goes looking for it.

Text messages get read. Industry data shows SMS open rates above 90%, most within minutes.

Switch the delivery this week:

1. Text the quote link the same day you leave the job, not after you're back at a desk.

2. Message: "Quote for [job] ready: [link]. Reply YES to book or call with questions."

3. No reply in 24 hours? Call them.

4. Opened but quiet at 72 hours? Send one more text.

Adapt the script to your job types.

Want this follow-up cascade built and running on its own?

DM SCALE

#HomeServices #Contractors #HVAC #Roofing #SmallBusinessGrowth
rationale: Reels still win reach for cold-audience teaching content, and this ships an unclaimed Education tactic (quote delivery channel + reply-YES script + 24/72hr cascade) distinct from every prior quote-cadence, missed-call, and review angle already shipped.
